name: Dan Kays Auto Repair
email_search: Searched Google Business aggregator pages (Birdeye, MapQuest/Yelp mirror), the Facebook page (login-walled, no public email), Yahoo Local, BBB (no listing found for this business) and Manta/Chamber of Commerce directories (403 blocked). No public email found anywhere. Channel = phone/SMS only.
own_site_checked_domains: dankaysautorepair.com (NXDOMAIN, confirmed via curl/getent - does not resolve)
own_site_check_result: Birdeye's aggregator profile lists 'http://www.dankaysautorepair.com/' as the business website, but that domain has NO DNS record (NXDOMAIN, confirmed independently with curl and getent). No live website exists under any tested variant. The user confirmed directly on Google Maps that the business listing has no Website button. Confirmed: no own website.
rating_source: Verified directly on Google Maps by the requester (no Website button present on the Google Business Profile). Third-party aggregators show slightly different numbers for the same business: Birdeye 4.7/121 (unclaimed profile, sourced mostly from Facebook), Yelp (via MapQuest mirror) shows 7 Yelp-only reviews. The Google Maps figures (4.8 / 112) are used on the site as the authoritative source per task instructions.

additional_reviews_found_not_used_verbat: Jim Brantley (Facebook, via Birdeye): paraphrased praise for owner 'Big Dan', said he has sent vehicles there for 14+ years without complaint. Not used as a verbatim quote because the exact original wording could not be confirmed.

Fabian L., Chandler D., Luis M., Jason A., L A. (Yelp, via MapQuest mirror): positive but truncated/paraphrased reviews mentioning alternator repair, same-day oil leak fix, oil changes and price-shopping comparisons. Not used verbatim for the same reason.
Penny Dodd (Birdeye): one negative review (difficulty finding the location). Excluded as per pipeline rules (only positive verbatim quotes used).
services_note: No published price list or itemized service menu found anywhere online for this business (typical for an independent shop with minimal web presence). Services shown on the site are the real, attested categories: general repair/diagnostics and routine maintenance (Yahoo Local description + Yelp reviews mentioning oil changes and oil-leak repair), battery testing (visible on a 'TROUBLE STARTING? WE TEST BATTERIES' shop banner in the real interior photo, plus a Yelp review describing an alternator repair), and brakes/tires (general 'Complete Auto Repair Service' signage plus visible tire-brand banners in the shop). All priced as 'call for a quote', per the adapted-variant rule (no published pricing).

photos.note: This business has an unusually small public photo footprint: no claimed Google Business Profile photos accessible to tooling, a login-walled Facebook page, and only 2 photos total on its Yelp listing (consistent with a reviewer's comment that 'it's surprising this place has so few reviews'). Both real Yelp photos were downloaded, verified as genuine JPEGs, and used; a third file is a cropped detail of the real sign from one of the two source photos (not a separate photo). This is below the 5-photo guideline; documented per task instructions rather than treated as an automatic fail, since the business has a real phone channel, a real verified address/rating, and enough real content to describe honestly without inventing anything.
photos.source: Yelp business photos (surfaced via a MapQuest/Yelp mirror page at startpage.mapquest.com), downloaded directly from s3-media0.fl.yelpcdn.com with a Chrome user agent, verified as real JPEGs with `file`, resized to max 1000px wide at quality 82-85.

files.description: Real exterior photo: Dan Kays Auto Repair shop front and freestanding sign on SE 4th St, Gainesville FL, showing the phone number (352) 371-3888 and an ASA (Automotive Service Association) member badge
Real interior photo: the shop floor with multiple two-post lifts, a vehicle up on a rack, tools and shop banners (including a battery-testing sign)
Cropped detail of the sign visible in gbp-storefront-sign.jpg, showing the 'Dan Kays / Complete Auto Repair Service / 352-371-3888' text and the ASA member badge clearly

template_base: templates/dark/index.html (Mizu dark example), fully recolored from champagne/gold to a steel-blue industrial palette sampled from the real shop sign's blue (#223C66) in the storefront photo
build_variant: Adapted variant per PIPELINE.md Fase 3 point 5: no published pricing (call for a quote), no social links (none found), gallery reduced to 3 real image tiles instead of 6-8 given the limited photo count, phone-based CTAs throughout (no WhatsApp/booking platform confirmed for this business), real street address so a live Google Maps embed was used instead of a substitute photo.
notes: Phone, address, 'no own website' and ASA-member status are all independently verified from multiple sources (Birdeye, MapQuest/Yelp mirror, the business's own sign visible in its real photo, and the user's direct Google Maps check). Rating/review count (4.8 / 112) come from the user's direct Google Maps verification, which differs slightly from third-party aggregator snapshots (Birdeye 4.7/121, Yelp 7 reviews) -- normal for aggregators that update on different schedules; the Google Maps figures are treated as authoritative.
